document_title: Corrected prefiled testimony of Eric R. Dembek, clean and redlined version
filer: Old Dominion Electric Cooperative (witness Eric R. Dembek)
note: CORRECTION of version-pair D. Filing states the clean version 'should replace the original version in its entirety'; includes clean + redlined text.
how_obtained: Fetched the PDF from the Virginia SCC DocketSearch document handler (https://www.scc.virginia.gov/DocketSearch/Home/Document/12/<DocID>) with curl -L, following the site's 307 redirect to the lowercase /docketsearch/home/document/12/<DocID> path, which returned Content-Type application/pdf. The DocID was obtained from the DocketSearchAPI Breeze endpoint GetDocuments (?$filter=MATTER_NO eq <matter>) for this case. Converted the PDF to text with pypdf 6.14.2 using page.extract_text() concatenated per page with '===PAGE n===' separators. The text is saved exactly as pypdf produced it: not cleaned, not reflowed, not de-hyphenated; soft hyphens, ligature artefacts, transposed line-number/Q-A ordering and OCR-style noise are left intact.
